fixture_provenance.source: Unmodified existing repository CK04 and Van Hamme CSV fixtures; no generated surrogate atmosphere or downloaded replacement
fixture_provenance.scope: Solar metallicity; CK04 temperature brackets 5250/5500 at logg3,10000/10250 at logg4,25000/26000 at logg4.5. Linear V/bolometric LD plus logarithmic V and square-root bolometric tests. Not general data-release/model accuracy or resolution convergence.

semantics: Original CPU nearest gravity and metallicity, temperature bracketing and source revision/error policy
Original CPU wavelength alignment, boundary stripping and actual response multiplication, including atlas bolometric limits
Device unique-spectrum Simpson functional, full-precision T4 weights, face remapping, same-band optical-depth division and fresh occultation
Original CPU piecewise-linear LD in T/logg and ordered metallicity source-table selection; no new gravity/metallicity interpolation
Numerically ambiguous atlas selection or LD convex-hull boundaries use whole original CPU curve; no implicit prior exclusions
Source file/response changes rebuild fresh spectra/LD; immutable prepared packet and strict no-transfer evaluation tested
CPU Observer/fitter defaults and error classes unchanged; mixed/other atlases, spots, eccentric/contact or resource failures retain complete CPU fallback
threshold_basis: Existing gates unchanged. Boundary fallback margin is four times the existing 3e-13 state relative gate; it changes dispatch, not numerical acceptance or physical priors.

timing_conditions.matched: Same independently restored window, affinity0-15, Nice10, BLAS/OMP/MKL threads1. Three warm samples, fixed order, warm source/interpolator/quadrature caches; separate CPU and GPU drivers.
timing_conditions.curve: Matching host V/bolometric outputs, all CPU preparation/LD/reflection/hull work, response/source checks, transfers and device work. Binary constructor outside all curve timers. Engine/first-call costs separate.
timing_conditions.fitting: Original physical parameter/candidate construction, normalization/mapping/statistics included. Object/first callback separate. Public fit/sampler costs include original setup, all calls, compilation incurred and serialization; runtime/source caches may be warm from gates.
timing_conditions.cpu_radiance_hybrid: An ablation of the newly supported table hybrid using original CPU spectral integration/interpolation, not a preceding GPU table implementation.
timing_conditions.development: Supplementary CPU checks forced CPU on cores16-19/Nice19 while production ran; overlapping CPU checks excluded from matched timings.

resource_domain.components: Both bb or both CK04; mixed/other atlases use CPU
